snippet.title: UniversiaTCG Celestial Spheres Introduction
snippet.description:
The Celestial Spheres are a defensive deck based on Angels that work well with the Universia generic universe. Play them today on UniversiaTCG.

Demo on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5043790/UniversiaTCG/?beta=0
